OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_AutoStart.name: Internal llama.cpp runtime activation
OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_AutoStart.tooltip: When enabled, starts the PATH llama executable on 127.0.0.1 at the configured port now and on each ComfyUI startup.

OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_PathStatus.name: PATH availability
OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_PathStatus.tooltip: Whether the llama executable is available on ComfyUI's PATH.

OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_ExecutablePath.name: llama executable path
OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_ExecutablePath.tooltip: The resolved executable path when llama is available.

OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_CtxSize.name: Context size
OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_CtxSize.tooltip: Takes effect the next time the internal server starts; editing this does not restart a running server.

OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_Port.name: Internal server port
OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_Port.tooltip: Takes effect the next time the internal server starts; editing this does not restart a running server.

OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_ModelDir.name: LLM models directory
OllamaImageList_LlamaCpp_ModelDir.tooltip: Selects the directory used by the internal llama server on its next start; changing it does not restart a running server.
